task.description:
WF-02, TEST-FIXER after FAIL of step 5b pass 2 (handoffs/E2E105-20261105-01/step-05d-test-design-validator.json): fix F4 and F5 in the tests only, by decisions/0109 'Addendum 2026-11-09 (ORCH, WF-02 step 5b, after the second pass of the test gate)': О17 corrected, the approach changes, О18 corrected. Your result goes to the LAST pass (3 of 3) of the gate; a third FAIL stops the run. So measure before you write, and look for surviving mutants yourself before you hand over. The code under test (tools/src, tools/test/e2e/kit/*, the stand-in, tools/README.md, package.json) is right and is not changed.

F4, tools/test/e2e/picker.e2e.js, test 'isolation' and its helpers. (a) The rule for the list of A's texts: a one-word text of A is compared with whole string values only when it occurs as a part of some ru string of B's tenant file (any field of the file: questions, solutions, rules, result texts); every other text of A, and every text with a blank, is looked for as a part of every string value of B's answers; the solution names of A as a part of the answer text; the page text of B for every text of A as a part; the control of 10 stays. Measure the exceptions first (the gate found «человек», «Средний», «Обучение»). (b) The change of approach, an oracle of B's own strings, both pairs: first measure on the correct server, without a browser, (1) whether the texts of B's served questionnaire answer (lang=ru: the name, the intro, and the title, help, unit and option labels of each question) equal the ru texts of B's tenant file field by field, and (2) whether every string value of B's result answer for B's own set is a string value of B's tenant file (any field, any depth). Then assert (1) and (2) in the test on the answers the page received. A field that the server composes itself and that is not a string of the file (for example a version hash or the language) is named in the test with its reason, and only that field is left out of (2); report each such field. If (1) or (2) does not hold on the correct server for another reason, stop and report the exact difference in result.issues instead of loosening anything. (c) Comments say the rule, О17 corrected and the reason. Then show on copies outside the project, each with the assertion that catches it: W01, W02, N05 and N09 of the gate and their forms for the second pair; N01 to N04, N06 to N08, P13 and its v3 form still red; and at least three own mutants that only the new oracle can catch (for example the common word «человек» of A placed inside another string of B's questionnaire answer, and a text placed inside a string of B's result answer).

F5, tools/test/e2e-stand.test.js, E2S-13: add the deterministic case of V12 the way the gate's probe (<scratch>/e2e105g2/probe/v12-probe.test.js, outside the project) does it, as a second stand inside E2S-13 with no new test id: the stand-in in mode ignore-term; a deps.spawn that hands the starter 'exit' (code 0) and 'close' as soon as the log of the stand-in shows 'term' and does not pass on the real ones; one groupGone check right after stop() resolves, then the bounded waitGone; the stand removed by pid in finally if anything failed. Show V12 red in E2S-13 alone in at least 30 of 30 runs (quiet and under load), and the correct code green in a series of dozens of runs under load of E2S-13 alone and in several runs of the whole file.

THEN: each changed test alone; the independence loop of the nine spec tests (each name alone: exit 0, exactly one line that starts with 'ok ', and it is 'ok 1 - <name>'); npm run -s e2e -- picker three times (one Chrome at a time) with duration_ms; the two kit files three times; the counts of test( and assert. not lower than now (picker.e2e.js 139 assert., e2e-stand.test.js 205 assert.); npm run check once at the end, exit 0. Every edit and why the test (not the code) is to blame goes into result.changes. RULES: change only the two files of the write set; no skip, no sandbox flags, no sleep (waits for facts with limits); do not commit, push or pull; kill only your own processes by explicit pid; the ten old node processes of this machine (two 'node stand.js' with a working folder outside the project, eight 'node -e setInterval') are not yours. The handoff holds no absolute machine paths and no names of the owner's other projects.

the test asserts B's questionnaire texts equal B's file and every string of B's result answer is a string of B's file (composed fields named with reasons); measured on the correct server first
W01, W02, N05, N09 (both pairs), N01-N04, N06-N08, P13 and at least three own mutants red on copies, each with the catching assertion

result.summary: Rework for FAIL of handoffs/E2E105-20261105-01/step-05d-test-design-validator.json (gate pass 2 of 3), findings F4 (Medium) and F5 (Low), by decisions/0109, the addendum after the second pass (О17 corrected, the change of approach, О18 corrected); fixed in the tests only, the code under test is right and was not touched. What failed: (F4) the rule 'a one-word text of A is compared with whole string values only' was wider than its measured reason and hid A's own name inside a string of B: the gate's N05 (in B's questionnaire answer) and N09 (in B's result answer) survived `isolation` in both pairs; and a list of A's texts sees only the leaks it lists (the same error came back after a rework, so the approach changes). (F5) V12 (stop() does not wait for the group after its final SIGKILL) was caught in E2S-13 only by the timing of the system. What was fixed: (1) tools/test/e2e/picker.e2e.js, the list of A's texts: the one-word exception is computed from B's tenant file - only a one-word text of A that stands as a part inside a Russian text of B's file (any field) is compared with whole string values; measured first and pinned in the test: «человек», «Средний» (uchet-pro then svet-marketing), «Обучение» (agency then stock); every other text of A, A's name among them, is looked for as a part of every string value; the same rule now also covers the error answer that B's address gives to A's leader set (it was searched only for A's solution names: the same kind, one more place); the solution names of A, the check of B's page text and the control of 10 are unchanged. (2) The oracle of B's own strings, both pairs, on the answers the page received: the visitor texts of B's questionnaire answer (the name, the intro, and the title, help, unit and option labels of each question) equal the ru texts of B's tenant file field by field; every string value of B's result answer, and of B's questionnaire answer, is a string value of B's tenant file (any field, any depth). Measured first on the correct server without a browser: (1) holds (45 and 22 fields equal); (2) holds for the result answer with no composed field (56 and 34 strings, all strings of the file); B's questionnaire answer has exactly three fields that the server composes, `version` (the sha256 of the bytes of B's file), `lang` ('ru') and `languages` (['ru','kk','en']): named in the test with the reason, left out of the membership check and checked against those values instead. (3) tools/test/e2e-stand.test.js, E2S-13: a second stand as in the gate's probe (mode ignore-term; deps.spawn spawnEndingAtTerm hands the starter 'exit' (0) and 'close' as soon as the log shows 'term' and never the real ones; one groupGone check right after stop() resolves, then the bounded waitGone; stopQuietly and the kill by pid from the log in finally). Shown on copies outside the project with the final test files (Chrome one at a time; the gate's edits taken unchanged from its list): every mutant below is red in `isolation`, by the assertion named in self_check. W01, W02 and their second-pair forms W01-v3, W02-v3 (the list of A's texts); N05 and N05-v3 (the list: «Учёт-Про» / «Лидвейв» in B's questionnaire answer) and N09 and N09-v3 (the list: the same names in B's result): F4 is closed; N01, N02, N03, N04, N06, N07, N08, P13 (by the control of 10 in pair 1, as before), P13-v3 (the card of B shows «Лидвейв»), and also P16, P20, W03 of the gate. Own mutants that only the new checks of this step catch, each red now and green (9 of 9) on the test files as they were before this step: O1 and O1-v3 (a word that B's texts also hold, «человек» / «Обучение», appended inside B's first question title: check (1)), O2 and O2-v3 («Средний» / «Обучение» inside the summary of B's first solution in B's result: check (2)), O3 and O3-v3 (the summary of A's first solution as B's: check (2)), O4-v3 (agency's look headline as stock's: check (2) of the questionnaire answer), O5-v3 («Обучение» inside stock's look headline: the same), O6 and O6-v3 (A's version in B's questionnaire answer: the composed field version), O7 (B's error answer to A's set names A's tenant: the list rule on that answer). V12 (the gate's exact edit): E2S-13 alone red 30 of 30 quiet (all 30 by the new check 'ignore-term: the group after stop()'), 30 of 30 under 8 busy loops (20 by the new check, 10 by the old check of the first stand) and 30 of 30 under 12 busy loops (10 and 20); the whole file red 5 of 5. The correct code: E2S-13 alone green in 60 runs under 8 busy loops, in 120 runs under 10 busy loops (load average 11.85 at the end) with 6 whole-file runs at the same time (20 of 20 each), and in 30 quiet runs; the whole file of a copy 5 of 5. Then: the independence loops 9 of 9 (spec) and 20 of 20 (starter); npm run -s e2e -- picker x3: duration_ms 17157, 17081, 17239; the two kit files x3: 72 of 72 each; counts picker.e2e.js test( 12 (was 12), assert. 144 (was 139), e2e-stand.test.js test( 22 (was 22), assert. 211 (was 205); npm run check exit 0 (2026-11-09T00:46:30Z to 2026-11-09T00:51:11Z; npm test 2207 of 2207 pass, the e2e record command=npm run e2e selection=all exit=0 duration_ms=34833). issues.text: The fields that the server composes, as the task asks to report each: B's result answer - none (measured in both pairs: every string value is a string of B's tenant file: the texts and ids of solutions, rules and hypotheses, the ids of the questions and options answered). B's questionnaire answer - three: `version` (the sha256 of the bytes of the tenant file, design REQ-056, 5.2), `lang` (the language asked) and `languages` (the languages of the file, the keys of its texts). The task names check (2) for the result answer; this step applies it to B's questionnaire answer as well, because check (1) reads only the visitor texts, and without it a text of A or a word that B's texts also hold placed in look or leads of B's answer was not seen (O4-v3, O5-v3: green on the test before this step, red now). The three composed fields are named in the test (composedFields) with the reason and are left out of the membership check; they are not left unchecked: their values are asserted (the sha256 of B's file bytes, 'ru', ['ru','kk','en']), so A's version in B's answer is red too (O6, O6-v3).

For DOC-UPDATER at step 10: criterion 6 of REQ-105 gets the precision of decisions/0109 О17 as corrected after the second pass (the one-word exception computed from B's file, measured words «человек», «Средний», «Обучение») and the oracle of B's own strings (checks (1) and (2), the composed fields), and the same list rule on the error answer to A's set at B's address, with before_copy; design 4.4 (the helper row 'exclusiveStrings(qA, qB)'; new helpers visitorTexts, commonWords, assertTextsOfFile, composedFields, assertOwnStrings), section 8 row 6 and section 11.1 row E2S-13 (the second stand: mode ignore-term with deps.spawn spawnEndingAtTerm, the check right after stop(), the mutant V12) describe the tests before this step. О18 as corrected is now met: V12 is red in E2S-13 alone 90 of 90 (30 quiet, 60 under load) and in the whole file 5 of 5, so S22 stays the only recorded survivor of the design's list.

A check that lists the leaks it looks for (here: the texts of A) sees only the leaks it lists; the complement oracle - B's answers hold B's own data only, field by field against B's file and every string a string of B's file - catches a leak whatever its words (O1-O5 survived the list and are red now). Its exceptions are a hole unless each is pinned by its own oracle instead of being skipped (O6: A's version in B's answer is red only because `version` is asserted, not skipped).
